title: Introducing the Mastra Agency Program
summary: A network of certified agencies and consultancies that build Mastra agents for their clients, plus our five launch partners.
body_markdown:
Today we're launching the **Mastra Agency Program** : a network of certified agencies and consultancies that build Mastra agents for their clients.


Many teams want agents in production but lack in-house expertise. Over the last year, we've met a ton of incredible folks building agents with Mastra for clients. They bring hands-on experience from dozens of builds, know what it takes to make an agent reliable at scale, and stay on to run what they ship.


Because there are so many agencies to choose from, we wanted to create a list of reliable partners building on Mastra.


Every partner in the Mastra Agency Program has been vetted by our FDE team. Each one has a direct line to me, Shane, Abhi, and the entire team, regular partnership updates, roadmap updates and a voice in where it goes (this moves incredibly quickly!).


If you're building agents for clients and are interested in partnering,[chat with us](https://calendly.com/brandon-mastra/agency-call) !


## Launch partners


We're launching with 5 agency partners:


Deerfield Group is a fully integrated marketing, media, communications, and technology agency built for the pace and complexity of pharmaceutical, biotechnology, health tech, and consumer health companies. Deerfield Group's model pairs senior-level strategy and human judgment with technology. A senior core team stays close with flexible capability to scale as needed across strategy, creative, digital, media, PR, analytics, sales enablement, and print. Built for This—and what's next.


**[Reach out](https://deerfieldgroup.com/contact-us)**


---


Blue Drop Labs is a founder-led digital consulting firm that brings design, development, and AI together to solve business problems. It builds websites and applications, manages infrastructure, and automates workflows, with senior practitioners guiding projects from strategy through delivery. The team combines human judgment with AI tools to improve customer experiences, reduce operating costs, and help teams move faster.


**[Reach out](https://bluedroplabs.com/contact)**


---


Frontleap is AI order management for SAP, purpose-built for manufacturers and distributors. It triples the output of sales associates with one workspace for order entry and customer advice, powered by each company's own catalog, pricing, and exceptions. Frontleap runs alongside SAP without modifying it, with 9 SAP modules connected.


**[Reach out](https://calendar.app.google/hpZN7YZhBMutqwri8)**


---


Handpicked is a collective of 11 specialized digital and creative agencies across the Netherlands. Its roughly 300 people work where strategy, AI, digital marketing, design, and development meet. With teams in Rotterdam, Breda, Eindhoven, and Amsterdam, Handpicked pairs deep specialization with the scale of a whole group.


**[Reach out](https://calendly.com/d/d2ks-7nf-sqf/handpicked-agencies)**


---


Young Security is an agentic engineering agency that designs, builds, and operates production AI agents on Mastra. The team brings more than 25 years of cybersecurity and infrastructure experience and applies Zero Trust principles to every deployment, so the systems it delivers are secure by design and transparent in how they run. Its work ranges from[company brains](https://mastra.ai/company-brain) and[customer-facing assistants](https://mastra.ai/customer-facing-agents) to multi-agent automation of critical processes, taking clients from prototype to a resilient, monitored production environment. The approach stays the same throughout: close client relationships, clear communication, and practical solutions matched to each organization's real needs.


**[Reach out](https://cal.com/youngsecurity)**


## New partners


Agentic Engineering is Mastra's first agency partner in Mexico and Latin America, working in English and Spanish with companies in the US and across the Spanish-speaking community. It takes clients from their first workflow worth automating to AI products their customers or employees use. That covers assistants built on company knowledge, multi-agent automations and custom products such as Curia, the team's own Mastra-based workspace for Mexican law firms.


**[Reach out](https://agenticengineering.agency/#contact)**
